scope: Official product contracts; not evidence of any customer's installed tenant, records, permissions or accounting policy.

sources.title: API endpoint structure
sources.finding: Online host separates environment /v2.0 from API route /api/v2.0; tenant can be in path. Partner routes include publisher/group/version. Company can be path GUID or query parameter.

sources.title: company resource
sources.finding: Read actual company id, name, systemVersion and source timestamps; names do not replace GUID scope.

sources.title: Table system fields
sources.finding: SystemId is immutable GUID; a native business number is a distinct key. Audit fields are platform-managed; rowversion is not a wall-clock time.

sources.title: generalLedgerSetup resource
sources.finding: Exposes actual localCurrencyCode, additionalReportingCurrency, posting bounds and shortcutDimension1Code through shortcutDimension8Code.

sources.title: Get generalLedgerSetup
sources.finding: Documented individual GET includes company GUID and setup GUID; response is one object, not a value array. Sample GUID is illustrative.

sources.title: companyInformation resource
sources.finding: currencyCode is documented as company default currency. General Ledger Setup is the direct LCY source.

sources.title: currency resource
sources.finding: amountDecimalPlaces is a string; amountRoundingPrecision is decimal. Preserve exact source settings and actual currency identity.

sources.title: Currencies in Business Central
sources.finding: LCY is defined in General Ledger Setup; blank transaction currency represents LCY. G/L entries carry LCY; original foreign currency requires its source documents. Additional reporting currency is separate.

sources.title: dimension resource
sources.finding: Dimension GUID/code identifies an axis; dimensionValues is its navigation.

sources.title: dimensionValue resource
sources.finding: Value GUID/code retains its dimensionId. Do not join a value code across unrelated dimensions.

sources.title: dimensionSetLine resource
sources.finding: id is the line GUID. Parent identity/type and code/valueId/valueCode are available; numeric internal Dimension Set ID is not listed.

sources.title: Get dimensionSetLines
sources.finding: Documented reads include generalLedgerEntries(parentGUID)/dimensionSetLines(lineGUID). Use actual parent-scoped identities.

sources.title: defaultDimension resource
sources.finding: Default records include parentId/type, dimensionId/code, dimensionValueId/code and postingValidation. Defaults are separate from posted dimension-set lines.

sources.title: Work with dimensions
sources.finding: Two global and up to eight shortcut dimensions do not replace full sets. Priorities and blocked combinations can affect posting; defaults can change on document lines.

sources.title: fixedAsset resource
sources.finding: Standard master fields do not establish an acquisition, depreciation-book or ledger balance export.

sources.title: Update fixedAssets
sources.finding: PATCH requires If-Match; stale tag prevents update. Omitted fields remain or may recalculate. Example IDs/extra financial fields conflict with the resource table, so installed metadata and actual response govern.

sources.title: generalLedgerEntry resource
sources.finding: Read-only ledger has native GUID/entry number/document/date/account, exact debit/credit, separate additional-currency amounts, and dimensionSetLines navigation.

sources.title: Set up general fixed assets information
sources.finding: Opening FA cost and accumulated depreciation are separate entries per book; G/L integration state matters. Preserve supplier-approved opening/history strategy and avoid duplicate posting.

sources.title: Fixed assets reports
sources.finding: Book Value, Register, Document Nos. and G/L Analysis provide different accounting readback populations.

sources.title: API v2.0 overview
sources.finding: Published standard APIs are finite; additional fields require an actual supported custom API or export, not a guessed standard field.

sources.title: Get defaultDimensions for an entity
sources.finding: Documents company-level and selected item/customer/vendor/employee default-dimension routes; actual installed metadata and responses remain authoritative.
